name: Cars
summary: Air readings from SenseCAP sensors in school cars: temperature, humidity, CO2 and, where fitted, particles. Positions are never public.

el.name: Αυτοκίνητα
el.summary: Μετρήσεις αέρα από αισθητήρες SenseCAP σε αυτοκίνητα σχολείων: θερμοκρασία, υγρασία, CO2 και, όπου υπάρχουν, σωματίδια. Οι θέσεις δεν είναι ποτέ δημόσιες.

variables.note: only where a sensor has a particle channel

quality.uncertainty: Measures the air around the car, not the weather of the whole town. Windows, air conditioning and passengers change it.
known_issues: Heat and sun on a parked car raise temperature
Units on moving vehicles drift faster than fixed ones

privacy.note: Exact positions of cars and buses are never public. Public positions are at least 2 hours old and rounded to 0.01 degree (about 1 km).

use_for: Air around roads at school-run times
Comparing a car with a bus on similar routes
not_for: Claiming what the whole city breathes
